description:
Ostinato watches how you sit and stand while you practice guitar, voice, or piano — each instrument has its own lesson library, filmed against real teachers' technique.

What it measures, it reports plainly. Today it measures one thing: how far your trunk leans while you play, shown as a band against real teachers' footage — not a fake precise number. Your skeleton is drawn live during a lesson so you can see what the camera reads.

MEASURED
- How far your trunk leans while you play, compared to real teachers

NOT MEASURED
- Pitch, rhythm, chords, or technique — there is no microphone in this build; every judgment today comes from the camera
- Anything below your hips, or your arms in detail — the reference footage this is built from is filmed waist-up

Your camera view never leaves your device, and neither does the video itself or the frame-by-frame measurement — both are gone the moment the lesson ends. A short summary of each session (how long you played, how much you stayed in range) is kept on this device so you can see your last session; uninstalling the app removes it.

This is a practice tool, not a medical device. It does not diagnose anything, and nothing it shows is treatment advice.

Guitar, voice, and piano are live today. Every other instrument in the app is named honestly — never disguised as a course we have not built.

Honestly measured practice, one instrument at a time.
$measurementDisclosureLine: MEASURED / NOT MEASURED ikilisi (JabLab'in uclusunun DAR karsiligi — kendi olcum yuzeyimiz daha kucuk, uc katman UYDURMAK yerine iki katman DOGRU tutuldu; JabLab'in kendi 'WHAT WE DO NOT MEASURE' baslik desenine uyuldu, 'YET' EKLENMEDI — O-157'nin PROMISE_PATTERNS taramasi 'yet'i her baglamda yasakliyor). Kaynak: settings_screen.dart'in kendi kamera karti gerekcesi ('it measures one thing: how far your trunk leans') + PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy'nin H-34 taramasi (google_fonts-disi sifir ag) + session_store.dart (D14, bugun). Elbow/shoulder/forearm icin 'watched, not scored' (JabLab'in uclu katmani) katilMADI — D6'da bu EKSIK-DOGRULANDI diye yazilmisti, O-164'te (2026-08-16) TAM DOGRULANDI: uc ruleset'in de (voice/piano/guitar) `referenceConsumption.coached_only` dizisi VE `userExplanation` alani VAR ('Experienced {calgi} teachers disagree about these, so we point them out but do not grade them') — ama `lesson_demo_screen.dart`in KENDI ekrani bunu yalanliyor: kart basligi 'Your elbow angle, WHEN THIS IS LIVE' (henuz degil) + ayri bir uyari 'Elbow tracking is not wired into this build — only trunk posture measures live today.' Yani ruleset SEVIYESINDE dirsek/omuz/onkol icin GERCEK referans-veri + esik-karari var (8/9 eklem, 3 calgida da AYNI set) ama CANLI PIPELINE (`CameraPostureAdapter`) bu eklemleri HIC OKUMUYOR — yalniz statik bir ogretmen-araligi (ArmRangeHint) gosteriliyor, canli bir SAYI degil. 'Watched, not scored' demek 'watched' kismini UYDURURDU — dogru cerceve 'reference exists, live tracking does not', ve bu JabLab'in tempo-hatasinin (olculuyor ama gosterilmiyor) TAM AYNISI olurdu. Description'da EKSIK birakilmaya DEVAM EDILDI, ama artik tahmin degil olcum: `lib/` grep + `lesson_demo_screen.dart`in kendi 'not wired' cumlesi.
$micClaimWhy: Ruleset'ler (config/rulesets/{voice,piano,guitar}@0.2.0-draft.json) `metrics` altinda pitch_deviation_cents/periodicity/level_above_room_floor_db/vibrato_rate_hz/chord_correctness/note_timing_ms/strum_timing_ms TASIYOR — ama bu KONFIG-UZAYI, SEVK EDILEN DEGIL. lib/ tarandi (grep): NSMicrophoneUsageDescription YOK, RECORD_AUDIO YOK, tek bir ses-yakalama cagrisi YOK; settings_screen.dart kendi karti bunu adiyla soyluyor ('No audio permission is requested... Until an input is wired, every judgement this app makes comes from the camera'). PRD'nin (G2) W1 kabul kriterleri (§7.2-3) bu ses metriklerini HEDEF olarak listeler — bugunku BUILD DEGIL. Magaza metni PRD'nin hedefini degil, bugunku kodun GERCEGINI yansitir.

$notClaimed: Bu taslak 'cihazda dogrulandi/kanitlandi' TURUNDE hicbir cumle icermiyor. Description'daki her cumle BUGUN kod-gercegine dayanir (lib/ grep + bu oturumdaki dogrudan okuma), PRD'nin hedef-durumuna degil. Cihaz-performansi/upload/submit iddiasi tasimaz — B7 kurucu kalemi.
$claimAuditWhy: F4/D6 taslagi (2026-08-16, O-156, orkestrator sevki: H-46 uyarinca attach/detach cagrilmadan). JabLab'in $claimAuditWhy'inin 3 dersi ONCEDEN uygulandi (kopyalanmadan ONCE): (1) 'saklanmiyor' KOK-DUZEYINDE kontrol edildi (session_store.dart D14, bugun) — description hem 'video hicbir zaman saklanmaz' hem 'ozet saklanir' ikisini de adiyla soyluyor, JabLab'in ucuncu-yuzey hatasina (description'in kendi ayri kopyasi kontrolsuz kalmasi) dusulmedi cunku BURADA description ILK YAZILDI, sonradan DUZELTILMEDI. (2) 'olculuyor ama gosterilmiyor' sinifi: ses metrikleri config'te TASINIYOR ama description'a HIC girmedi (yukarida $micClaimWhy) — JabLab'in tempo-hatasinin ayni sinifini ONCEDEN onledi. (3) 'MEASURED AND GRADED' asiri-iddiasi: description 'graded'/'scored' kelimesini HIC kullanmiyor, yalniz 'measures'/'reports' — ruleset'in coached_only katmani (voice/piano/guitar'in ucunde de AYNI 8 kol-eklemi) O-164'te TAM dogrulandi VE canli pipeline'in bu eklemleri hic okumadigi ortaya cikti (bkz $measurementDisclosureLine, lesson_demo_screen.dart'in kendi 'not wired' itirafi) — o katman description'a YINE eklenmedi, ama artik EKSIK-oldugu icin degil, YANLIS olacagi icin (JabLab'in tempo-hatasinin ayni sinifi: olculen-ama-gosterilmeyen bir seyi 'watched' demek).
